expression.description: JavaScript expression as string to show the conditional tooltip.

content.description: The string that will be shown in the tooltip

title:
Helper type for {@link UiSdlReliabilityIconCell} to define a conditional tooltip with a JavaScript
expression. `value` in #expression can be used as the value at fieldPath in dataItem.
E.g., if the following expression passed, the tooltip would be "This is a tooltip".

```json
{
  "expression": "value > 10",
  "content": "This is a tooltip"
}
```
name: UiSdlReliabilityIconCellExpressionToTooltip
